notes.title: 23/05/04 Update Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41748810/8a1fede2213883ec6218d9673a6693d276d5e1ed.png[/img]

[23/05/04] Update Notice

A new feature has been added to Gretel and Winslow's Mansion!

[b]1. Achievements[/b]
Total 20 Achievements were added.
Play the game and collect the Achievements!

[b]2. 'Memory Collection Room'[/b]
'Memory Collection Room' function has been added on the main.
Once the ending is achieved, ornament will be added to the 'Memory Collection Room'.
You can re-view the ending scene by clicking on the added ornament.
You can collect a total of four ornaments.

Thank you for enjoying our game.

notes.title: 22/06/04 소규모 업데이트 알림
notes.content:
